card.title: Customs Interpreter
card.instruction: Act as the translator of unwritten customs. Correct breaches, explain exceptions, and make your usefulness proof that you belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your family's dinners, that chair stays empty for your aunt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only her grandchildren can borrow it. I learned that at Easter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then take mine. I'll fetch another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours faces the kitchen; whoever sits there explains the dishes. Yes, I know them all now.

mechanism: A translates family seating exceptions and accepts a role through knowing the dishes, making learned custom useful evidence of belonging.
confusable: Unlike hoarding secrets to preserve seniority, A explains unwritten rules and demonstrates practical usefulness to gain inclusion.
comparison: The family alternative earns a seat by explaining food; the club alternative claims an adviser role through translating proposal, lunch and seating conventions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
